items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears. Hollywood Brown OUT.
items.why: Cleared after stinger/MRI; full practice progression
items.implication: Start both confidently in all formats; no residual limitation expected
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries/targets for Barkley; Smith primary WR

items.text: Caleb Williams officially ruled OUT for MNF vs Eagles. Tyson Bagent returned to practice and is Q.
items.implication: Bears offense downgrade; monitor Bagent for any spot-start or DFS value if cleared
items.opportunity: Potential boost to Bears RBs/WRs volume if game script allows, but overall lower ceiling

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday night vs DEN (hip/groin). ETR and multiple reports indicate he is not expected to play.
items.why: Hip/groin injury; McVay comments and final report
items.implication: Start Davante Adams and other Rams pass-catchers with elevated targets/routes
items.opportunity: Adams likely sees heavy target share and red-zone work

items.text: Nico Collins OUT (hamstring) vs IND. Confirmed across ETR list, Schefter-aligned reports, and injury trackers.
items.implication: Dalton Schultz elevated to high-end TE1 with 28-30% target share expected
items.opportunity: Schultz 28% target share last week with Collins out; Colts allow 4th-most TE yards

items.text: Broncos RB Jonah Coleman (high-ankle) placed on short-term IR; expected back late October vs ARI. Hits RB depth with Dobbins/Harvey returning.
items.implication: Dobbins + Harvey committee clearer; no Coleman handcuff needed short-term

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT. Jaylen Warren (shoulder, Q) projected IN by Levitan/ETR and set for lead back + checkdown role.
items.implication: Warren becomes clear RB2/flex with expanded snaps, carries, and receiving work
items.opportunity: Warren lead back + checkdowns; averaged strong PPG on 15+ touches historically

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite Q tags. Seeking early clarity on Zay Flowers (ham), DJ Moore (shoulder), AD Mitchell.
items.why: Practice reports and ETR models; LP/full progression indicators
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers if no late downgrade; fade or GTD monitor Flowers/Moore
items.opportunity: Bowers immediate TE1 if active post-meniscus; Warren volume spike; Evans routes

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT (elbow). Jaxson Dart OUT (season-ending knee). Mariota/Haener/Winston backups elevated.
items.why: Elbow for Daniels; multi-ligament knee for Dart (surgery, IR)
items.implication: Commanders/Giants pass games downgraded; McLaurin still viable but lower floor
items.opportunity: Monitor Mariota usage with McLaurin (historical 25% share)

items.text: Jonathon Brooks OUT/IR (groin surgery, 6-8 weeks). Chuba Hubbard locked as lead back.
items.implication: Hubbard RB2+ with full workload; strong start candidate
items.opportunity: Hubbard already high utilization; expands carries/snaps/red-zone

items.text: Alec Pierce OUT/IR (heel). Josh Downs saw target share jump to 36% and expanded perimeter routes.
items.implication: Downs upgraded to every-week WR3/flex with higher volume
items.opportunity: 36% target share post-Pierce exit; more outside routes

items.text: Key INs: Malik Nabers, JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Travis Etienne, Jadarian Price, Aaron Jones, Sam Darnold. Nabers full go post-shoulder.
items.implication: Nabers WR1 lock with Winston; Dobbins/Harvey Broncos committee; Etienne viable but role-capped
items.opportunity: Nabers high target share expected; Price SEA depth; Harvey/Dobbins split after Coleman IR

items.text: Giants signed QB Jake Haener to active roster as backup Sunday (Dart season-ending).
items.implication: Winston likely starter; Haener emergency; Nabers still primary target
items.opportunity: Nabers volume intact or higher with aggressive backup

items.text: Bengals placed WR Andrei Iosivas on IR; elevated TE Tanner Hudson. Reinforces Tee Higgins/Ja'Marr Chase target concentration.
items.opportunity: Concentrated WR targets + Hudson TE spot work

items.text: LOVE Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: High carry share expected vs weak run D

items.text: LOVE Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games; RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
items.opportunity: Consistent touches/targets; PIT soft vs RBs

items.text: LOVE Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV allows 18.7 ypr to WRs); Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% share w/ Collins out, IND 4th-most TE yds); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, 38% RZ share).
items.why: Usage + matchups + Collins absence for Schultz
items.implication: Start all three confidently; Schultz TE1 stream
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz routes/targets; Watson RZ/red-zone

items.text: HATE Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches; JAX stout vs RBs); Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (SEA fewest FP to WRs, low team total, Daniels out).
items.why: Role/volume decline + tough matchups + QB downgrade
items.implication: Sit/fade; prefer Henderson over Stevenson; Etienne risky flex
items.opportunity: Henderson post-fumble lead (65% snaps); McLaurin historical Mariota share but matchup tanks it
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN; some still start McLaurin

items.text: 10 Facts: Henderson led NE snaps/touches post-Stevenson fumble (65%/16-5); Schultz 30% route rate/28% share w/ Collins out; London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds in 12 games w/ Penix.
items.implication: Henderson rising but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry; Schultz must-start; London smash w/ Penix
items.opportunity: Henderson pass-pro limits full takeover; Schultz TE volume; London target monster
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson short-term
